name: WISE 0855
blurb: The coldest brown dwarf known, about 7 light-years away. Colder than the North Pole, and one of the fastest movers on the sky.

name: Barnard's Star
blurb: A small red star 6 light-years away with the largest motion across the sky of any star: about 10 arcseconds per year.

name: Epsilon Indi B
blurb: A pair of brown dwarfs orbiting each other, and together orbiting the star Epsilon Indi, about 12 light-years away.

name: RW Aurigae
blurb: A young star still surrounded by a dusty disk. It dims unpredictably as clumps of dust pass in front of it.

name: R Draconis
blurb: An aging red giant that swells and fades over roughly 8 months: a classic pulsating variable star.

name: Orion Nebula
blurb: A stellar nursery where new stars are forming. Infrared light cuts through its dust to reveal hidden young stars.
